3. Adverse Event Narrative
A 73-year-old female received Dose 2 of mRNA-1273 (Spikevax) on 03 September 2025. Approximately 6 day(s) following vaccination, the patient developed symptoms consistent with Myocarditis. The patient sought medical attention and was hospitalized for observation. The outcome was recovering. The reporter does not consider the event related to mRNA-1273 vaccination.
